name: raw-data-interceptor
description: Cross-platform WebSocket data interceptor for Chrome, Firefox, and Electron

scripts.build:legacy: bun run build:clean && bun run build:types && bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --splitting
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format cjs --target browser
scripts.build:chrome: bun build src/platforms/chrome/index.ts --outdir dist/platforms/chrome --format esm --target browser
scripts.build:firefox: bun build src/platforms/firefox/index.ts --outdir dist/platforms/firefox --format esm --target browser
scripts.build:electron: bun build src/platforms/electron/index.ts --outdir dist/platforms/electron --format cjs --target node
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:chrome && bun run build:firefox && bun run build:electron
scripts.dev: bun run build:types && bun run test:watch
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run test
scripts.extension:chrome: bun run build:chrome && cp -r dist/platforms/chrome/* . && cp manifest.json dist/
scripts.extension:firefox: bun run build:firefox && cp -r dist/platforms/firefox/* . && cp manifest-firefox.json dist/
scripts.extension:electron: bun run build:electron && cp -r dist/platforms/electron/* . && cp package-electron.json dist/

author: RAW Data Interceptor Team
